definitions.K_LB: exact order-free lower bound over the declared finite pick x place modes under the union model (min movable discs in M_pick[i] u M_place[j])
definitions.K_cert: sound certificate: for EVERY set of K-1 movable discs, the real populated-scene screen with that set removed is certified closed (all declared candidates fail definitely) for the target pick or place; by monotonicity no correction moving fewer than K movable objects (to any destinations) can make the target feasible within the declared grasp family -> K_necessary,cert >= K
definitions.K_catalogue: fewest moves of a verified complete (X=1,Y=1, replayed) candidate in the frozen catalogue
definitions.K_verified_necessary: K_cert == K_catalogue: necessity certified AND a K-move repair physically witnessed

construction_rules_from_P19: blockers drawn from LOCAL pools (Chebyshev <= 2 of the target source for pick closure, of the goal for place closure)
K3 / K4 as distributed closure: pick-side Kp + place-side Kg with exact enumeration of the finite mode abstraction (no greedy certificate)
every accepted root must have K_cert == K_intent (real screens), S0 not certified-free (Y0 expected 0)

every intended relocation: blocker pick screen open (>= 2 modes) in its ideal predecessor scene, no analytic edge certificate, parking a short carry (Chebyshev 1-2 preferred) to a cell with >= 3 open place modes, off the reopened target modes' kill cells
after the full intended repair: >= 3 open target pick and >= 3 open place modes, no analytic certificate
task region preferring arm-comfortable cells (P19: success drops beyond 0.6 m from the base / columns 6-7)
no populated-scene motion planning during construction; no teacher call; no witness chasing

caps.why: K4 needs repair variants, 3 prefixes, 3 non-trivial omissions, 4 singles, order twins, controls; P16 caps (16/44) truncated only controls (P19 CAP_AUDIT) but leave no room for K4 variants

k2.role: geometry revision if k1 identifies a justified bottleneck; frozen as a new version before its labels

k3.role: coverage with the predeclared composition (>= 60% K3/K4, >= 15% K0 controls, >= 1 family not built by local closure)

readiness.counting: a root counts as verified K3 / K4 iff K_catalogue == K with complete replayed X+connector and Y witnesses AND every shorter F1-admissible catalogue candidate decided (no censored / unattempted); K_cert reported alongside (verified-necessary subset)

denominators: all attempted slots, rejections and CPU charged; the K-conditioned curriculum subset reported separately from the all-attempted generator distribution

primary_endpoints: unconditional repair success on initially infeasible roots
P21_analysis_plan.K34_hypotheses: to be frozen in the P21 design before training
